title: PvME/Sanctum of Rebirth/Sanctum HM Mechanics Overview

cues.text: Shards of moonstone mark your feet. Prepare to move!
Vermyx channels power from the Sanctum towards the west/east.
Vermyx fires a Soul bomb. Ready yourself!
I am afraid this is where your story ends.
The sanctum is mine to control.
The Sanctum will protect me while I only grow stronger.
Suffer the full power of the Sanctum!
Feel the power beneath your feet!
Suffer the full power of the Sanctum!
The Devourer will consume you soul!
